notes.title: Dev Blog #1 – Thank You, Early Alpha Update & Gameplay Reveal Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

First off, we want to send a massive thank you to everyone who has wishlisted Death Remains on Steam. Your support has been incredible, and it genuinely fuels our motivation to keep pushing this project forward. As a token of our appreciation, we’re excited to share with you our new [b]Gameplay Reveal Trailer[/b], which highlights some of the progress we’ve been making behind the scenes. We hope you enjoy the sneak peek into our zombie-infested world!

[previewyoutube=QXaXgAjWFVg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h1]What We’ve Been Up To This Week[/h1][/b]
It’s been a busy week for our small development team, and we’re thrilled to report that we have now moved into our Early Alpha Build, which is fully playable. While there’s still a lot of polishing and fine-tuning to do, the core systems are taking shape nicely. Here are some of the key achievements from the past few days:

[b][h2]Core Features Implemented[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Dynamic Faction Interactions: We’ve refined how factions react to player actions, forming alliances or turning hostile based on your decisions.
[*] Improved AI Behavior: Our zombies and wildlife are getting smarter.
[*] Vehicle Physics Upgrades: Driving cars moother and more realistic. Updated Vehicle upgrade menu.
[*] Skill Progression Tweaks
[/list]

[b][h2]Co-op & Multiplayer Refinements[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Server Stability
[*] UI/UX Upgrades
[/list]

[b][h2]Survival Mechanics Balancing[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fine-tuned hunger, thirst, and health systems to provide a tough but fair challenge. Remember, a single mistake can spiral quickly in Death Remains.
[/list]

[b][h1]Looking Towards August – A Potential Demo?[/h1][/b]
We’re aiming to share a more public release around August. Whether this will be a full Early Access release or a limited demo is still up in the air—but we want your feedback! Would you like to see a small playable demo before the full launch? Let us know in the comments or on our Discord. We’re seriously considering giving you an earlier hands-on experience to gather as much community feedback as possible.

[b][h1]Share Your Thoughts![/h1][/b]
We value our community more than anything else. If you have suggestions, feedback, or just want to chat about survival strategies, jump into our Discord or reach out on X (Twitter). We’re always eager to hear your ideas on how to shape Death Remains into the ultimate zombie survival game.
[list]
[*] Discord: discord.gg/hzrrPscTVc
[*] X (Twitter): x.com/DeathRemainsX
[*] Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/2986460
[/list]

[h1][b]Thank You Again[/b][/h1]
Your wishlists mean the world to us. Each wishlist pushes us closer to making our vision a reality—and we can’t wait to see you all surviving (and maybe thriving) in the world of Death Remains. Stay tuned for more weekly dev blogs, where we’ll keep you updated on everything from major feature overhauls to minor bug fixes.

Until next time, Survivors—stay safe, stay hungry for those resources, and keep the undead at bay!

[b]– The Death Remains Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Join Our Discord & Help Shape Our Game!
notes.notes:
